name: Skipo
description:
Connect Claude to your Skipo account for secure, read-only access to your balances and activity. Ask questions in plain language and get answers drawn directly from your live account data.

With this connector you can:
• Check balances across all your currencies and see how they've changed over time
• Review your transaction history — deposits, withdrawals, and conversions — with full status and detail
• Look up conversion orders, ledger movements, and your saved contacts
• Reference supported currencies and markets, and check service status

Authentication uses Skipo's secure OAuth sign-in: you approve access with your own Skipo login, and Claude only ever sees data you already have access to. The connector is strictly read-only — it cannot move funds, make conversions, change settings, or modify anything in your account.

Ideal for reviewing your portfolio, reconciling activity, or pulling account details into your workflow without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Skipo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Skipo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.skipo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Skipo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skipo lists 15 MCP tools, including check_api_health, get_account, get_balance_history, get_balances, get_contacts, get_deposits, get_markets, get_server_time, get_withdrawals, get_orders, get_fills, and get_order_fills.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Skipo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Skipo in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Skipo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Skipo is developed by Skipo Chile SpA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
